name: P21 (P021)
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: P21 (P021) is a linear synthetic peptide supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 2 pack sizes: 5 mg, 10 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is P21 (P021) tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: P21 (P021) is released lot by lot — HPLC for purity (≥99.0% (HPLC)) plus MS for mass — and the P21 certificate lists the measured values alongside the identity entry (CAS 1246751-68-7, formula C27H42N6O8, 578.67 Da).

faq.question: How should P21 (P021) be stored?
faq.answer: Hold the sealed 10-vial kit at −20 °C, away from light and humidity. Once reconstituted, aliquot and keep at 2–8 °C; this P21 preparation does not tolerate repeated freeze–thaw.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for P21 (P021)?
faq.answer: P21 (P021) is stocked in 2 pack sizes (5 mg, 10 mg), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $325.90; 10–49 kits falls to $299.82 (−8%) and 50+ to $277.02 (−15%).

compliance: For Research, Laboratory, and Analytical Use Only. Not for Human or Veterinary Use.
